primary_route: Proposed fixed-design bulk RNA-seq negative-binomial treatment-minus-control inference at independent allocation level, with immutable workflow and source-difference audit; no executed data or predictive training task.

checks.quote: # Proposed Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan (Design Only; No Execution Claimed)
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original RNA-seq Methods, supplements and release-specific validated tool/import protocols to select and verify transferable settings. Future source comparison or recording chosen settings is insufficient.

checks.quote: # Proposed Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan (Design Only; No Execution Claimed)
checks.reason: No primary allocation-level power/precision calculation is specified. A possible five-donor random-effect sensitivity calibrated later does not justify the main treatment replication.

checks.quote: PCA clustering with the wrong group
checks.reason: PCA placement alone is not evidence of a sample swap. This disjunctive exclusion rule permits outcome-related removal without independent identity confirmation, despite the separate warning against removing unfavorable samples.

checks.quote: Treatment allocated per donor, multiple donors, randomized within donor
checks.reason: The proposed branch conflates donor-level allocation with within-donor treatment crossing. Saturated donor indicators absorb a donor-constant treatment; a valid between-donor replicate model must be specified. The primary Wald/LRT choice is also unresolved.

checks.quote: # Proposed Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan (Design Only; No Execution Claimed)
checks.reason: No explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after modified procedures following failure.

checks.quote: confirm treatment separates as expected
checks.reason: Treatment separation is not a model-validity requirement: a true null or small effect may give no separation. A QC/acceptance gate must be based on measurement and model adequacy, not the hoped-for biological result.

checks.quote: # Proposed Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan (Design Only; No Execution Claimed)
checks.reason: The manifest/environment/audit are useful, but random seeds and resolved execution/thread settings are not specified; even the proposed random annotation-coordinate check has no recorded seed.

checks.quote: # Proposed Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan (Design Only; No Execution Claimed)
checks.reason: Two clean-directory reruns and timestamp handling are proposed, but numeric tolerances/data agreement and runtime/memory/resource-failure logs remain unspecified.

checks.quote: # Proposed Bulk RNA-seq Differential-Expression Analysis Plan (Design Only; No Execution Claimed)
checks.reason: Primary route is prospectively specified count-contrast inference, not prediction or feature-selection performance assessment. Its blinded pilot/calibration and frozen confirmatory specification are described; predictive train/test leakage is not an additional deduction. Independent/orthogonal confirmation is assessed separately under P14.
